children: Weyco Group entered into a Sixth Amendment to its Credit Agreement to extend the maturity of its secured revolving credit facility to September 23, 2027. The $40.0 million facility bears interest at one-month term SOFR plus 110 basis points and is secured by the company’s general business assets. The amendment makes no other material changes and includes customary covenants, including a minimum tangible net worth requirement. Management expects the extension to maintain liquidity and financial flexibility.
: Amendment to secured revolving credit facility (maturity extension to Sep 23 2027)
: Extend maturity and preserve liquidity flexibility
